# Creative Planning

Creative Planning is a TPA relationship — first determine whether payroll actually runs through Creative Planning or through the underlying payroll vendor (most often UKG).

## Routing & file format

- When payroll goes through Creative Planning, outbound files generally use the 1116 layout.
- Global SFTP for incoming and outgoing files is named CREATIVEPLANNING-LM.
- The global connection is generally used when Kelly Alves is assigned on the Creative Planning side for payroll.
- Some plans still work directly with the payroll vendor — use transition emails and early calls to confirm whether this is global Creative Planning or a separate vendor setup.
